v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Valde honorándus est * beátus Ioánnes, qui supra pectus Dómini in cena recúbuit.
text.en: Right worthy of honour * is the blessed Apostle John, who leaned on the Lord's bosom at the Last Supper.

text.la: Hic est discípulus ille * qui testimónium pérhibet de his: et scimus quia verum est testimónium eius.
text.en: This is the disciple * which testifieth of these things, and we know that his testimony is true.

text.la: Hic est discípulus meus: * sic eum volo manére, donec véniam.
text.en: This is My disciple * if I will that he tarry till I come?

text.la: Sunt de hic stántibus, * qui non gustábunt mortem, donec vídeant Fílium hóminis in regno suo.
text.en: There be some standing here, * which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man in His kingdom.

text.la: Ecce puer meus, * eléctus, quem elégi, pósui super eum Spíritum meum.
text.en: Behold My servant, * whom I have chosen, I have put My spirit upon him.

text.la: Qui timet Deum, fáciet bona: et qui cóntinens est iustítiæ, apprehéndet illam, et obviábit illi quasi mater honorificáta.
text.en: He that feareth God, will do good: and he that possesseth justice, shall lay hold on her, and she will meet him as an honourable mother.

v.la: Hic est discípulus ille, qui testimónium pérhibet de his.
v.en: This is that disciple who giveth testimony of these things.

r.la: Et scimus quia verum est testimónium eius.
r.en: And we know that his testimony is true.

text.la: Iste est Ioánnes, * qui supra pectus Dómini in cena recúbuit: beátus Apóstolus, cui reveláta sunt secréta cæléstia.
text.en: This is John * who leaned at supper on the bosom of the Lord. Blessed Apostle, to whom heavenly secrets were revealed.

text.la: Ecclésiam tuam, Dómine, benígnus illústra: ut beáti Ioánnis Apóstoli tui et Evangelístæ, illumináta doctrínis, ad dona pervéniat sempitérna.
text.en: Shine upon thy Church, O Lord, in thy goodness, that, enlightened by the teachings of Blessed John, thy Apostle and Evangelist, she may attain to everlasting gifts.

text.la: Glória in excélsis Deo, et in terra pax homínibus bonæ voluntátis, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: Glory be to God in the highest; and on earth, peace to men of good will, alleluia, alleluia.

v.en: The Lord hath made known, alleluia.

text.la: Concéde, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut nos Unigéniti tui nova per carnem Natívitas líberet; quos sub peccáti iugo vetústa sérvitus tenet.
text.en: Grant, we beseech thee, almighty God, that the new birth of thy Only-begotten Son as man may set us free, who are held by the old bondage under the yoke of sin.
